notes: לַחוּץ is fused with its copula under rules 30 and 49; splitting it would leave the preposition and article with nothing but *was*.
דֶּרֶךְ here is rendered wholly by *toward*, since the ASV writes no *way* for it in this clause — the same reading the chapter's other דֶּרֶךְ הַ- phrases take.
